We are seeking a PhD candidate to examine how collaborative AI affects collaboration and communication in blue-collar workplaces. The position is part of a new project that investigates how AI agents can support individuals and teams in coordinating and managing cognitively and physically demanding work. The project combines real-world fieldwork with hands-on design and development of AI-driven tools, with room to shape the direction based on the candidate's interests.

We offer an active, collaborative team in an international research environment committed to excellent research and a friendly atmosphere. The project is part of a Nordic collaboration that involves leading researchers from Finland, Sweden, and Norway. More about the project:

.

This is a three-year, fully funded position. Start date: April 2026. Location: Aalborg, Denmark.
